description: Source code for SCTP socket management, including socket creation, configuration, binding, connecting, listening, and setting socket options, with focus on SCTP protocol features and custom configurations.

classes.name: sctp_socket
classes.description: Class managing SCTP socket lifecycle, configuration, binding, connecting, and listening.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures an SCTP socket based on provided parameters.

methods.name: bindx
methods.description: Binds the socket to multiple addresses for multihoming.

methods.name: connectx
methods.description: Connects the socket to multiple addresses, establishing an SCTP association.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Sets the socket to listen for incoming SCTP connections.

methods.name: set_non_blocking
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: set_sockopts
methods.description: Configures socket options including SCTP-specific settings.

methods.name: get_bound_port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number the socket is bound to.

methods.name: get_address_family
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4 or IPv6) of the socket.
